title: etc_project
summary: A Jupyter Notebook project that trains synthetic-data generators on CSV files loaded from a local archive folder, producing sampled synthetic rows for downstream use. It directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer, fitting them on each field's dataframe and sampling synthetic data.
needs: No README present; unclear what domain/dataset ('etc') the synthetic data pipeline targets or how central this script is to the whole repo.
